page.layout: One scan showing a photographic target card and colour chart on grey mounting board; no printed text blocks of the book. Left: a white test chart with resolution bars, a grey scale and radial star targets, bearing the printed line "© 2007 digitalfoto-trainer.de" and the logo "BSB Bayerische StaatsBibliothek". Right: a colour checker chart without text.
page.notes: No text of the book is printed on this page. The only printed words are the imaging-target captions: "BSB Bayerische StaatsBibliothek" and "© 2007 digitalfoto-trainer.de", together with the scale numbers 0 to 60mm and the bar numbers 1 to 6. These are digitiser's calibration markings, not book text, and are left out. The page is a photographic target and not part of the book.
